evals.prompt: Buatkan struktur monorepo untuk aplikasi POS/kasir bernama 'kasir-app'. Backend pakai Go, frontend React. Saya butuh modul auth, users, products, dan orders. Tolong setup struktur folder lengkap beserta file konfigurasi pentingnya. Jangan jalankan npm install / go mod download, cukup buat struktur dan file-nya.
evals.expected_output: A monorepo with apps/web (React 19 + Tailwind 4) and apps/api (Go modular monolith using Air, golang-migrate, sqlc, not GORM), CLAUDE.md gateway, knowledge/, .claude/rules/, separate dev:web/dev:api scripts, single-app docker-compose with host DB, .env.example.
assertions: Monorepo has both apps/web and apps/api directories
Root CLAUDE.md exists as an AI gateway
knowledge/ directory exists with INDEX.md
.claude/rules/ directory exists
Root package.json has separate dev:web and dev:api scripts (no single combined dev that runs both, no concurrently)
Go backend uses Air watcher (.air.toml present)
Go backend uses golang-migrate (migrations/ with .up.sql/.down.sql) and sqlc (sqlc.yaml), and does NOT use GORM
Backend follows modular monolith: at least one module exposes a contracts/ boundary
.env.example present and no real .env containing secrets is committed
.env (gitignored) exists with local values: random JWT_SECRET, no __X__ / change-me placeholder; DB keys empty until db-local.mjs runs
docker-compose.yml defines a single app service and NO mysql/database service
Frontend uses React 19 + Tailwind 4 with @/* alias and a central Axios http-client

evals.prompt: Bikinin monorepo buat aplikasi blog sederhana namanya 'blog-app'. Backend Express/Node, frontend React. Setup struktur project-nya. Jangan jalankan npm install, cukup struktur dan file-nya.

CLAUDE.md, knowledge/, .claude/rules/, separate dev scripts, single-app docker-compose, .env.example.
assertions: Monorepo has both apps/web and apps/api directories

Express backend uses nodemon as the dev watcher (not a bare node server.js dev workflow)
Migration tool is NOT silently chosen: the output explicitly flags it as not-locked or asks for clarification
Backend follows modular monolith: at least one module exposes a contracts/ boundary

docker-compose.yml defines a single app service and NO mysql/database service
Frontend uses React 19 + Tailwind 4 with @/* alias and a central Axios http-client

evals.prompt: Buatkan project fullstack baru namanya 'toko-online', frontend sama backend sekalian. Setup struktur lengkapnya ya.
evals.expected_output: Claude WAJIB bertanya dulu backend mana yang dipakai (go / nestjs / express) sebelum menulis file apa pun.

Pertanyaan menyebutkan ketiga opsi terkunci: Go, NestJS, dan Express/Node
TIDAK ada file atau direktori project yang dibuat sebelum user menjawab
Claude TIDAK menanyakan pilihan frontend (frontend sudah terkunci React 19 + Tailwind 4)

evals.prompt: Jalankan scaffolder skill ini untuk backend go, nestjs, dan express (nama boleh bebas), lalu untuk setiap hasilnya jalankan npm install dan build (build:web, dan build:api untuk stack Node). Laporkan hasilnya.
evals.expected_output: Untuk ketiga stack, scaffold berhasil, npm install keluar dengan status 0, dan build:web serta build:api (Node) sukses tanpa error. Ini mengunci baseline "proyek hasil scaffold harus hidup" sebagai regression test.
assertions: Scaffold berhasil untuk go, nestjs, dan express tanpa error
npm install keluar dengan status 0 untuk ketiga stack
npm run build:web sukses untuk ketiga stack
npm run build:api sukses untuk nestjs dan express
Tidak ada langkah yang dilewati secara diam-diam tanpa dilaporkan

evals.prompt: Buatkan monorepo baru 'stokgudang' backend Go + React, nanti dideploy ke server saya (ssh host 'vps-acme', tanpa playbook). Port yang kosong 8085, repo GitHub acme/stokgudang, domain stokgudang.example.com. Siapkan juga file deploy-nya. Jangan jalankan npm install / go mod download dan jangan ubah apa pun di server.
evals.expected_output: A Go monorepo scaffolded with --slug stokgudang --port 8085 --ghcr-owner acme --domain stokgudang.example.com --ssh-host vps-acme, whose deploy setup follows references/docker-deployment.md: image built in CI and pushed to GHCR, image-only prod compose on 127.0.0.1:8085, host MySQL with stokgudang_db/stokgudang_user, host nginx site, no server changes.
assertions: .github/workflows/release-image.yml builds linux/amd64 and pushes ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>:<git-sha> only after the ci workflow succeeds on main
infra/deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml has no build: key, uses image ghcr.io/acme/stokgudang:${IMAGE_TAG:?...} and publishes only 127.0.0.1:8085:8080
No database/mysql service exists in any compose file
infra/deploy/deploy.sh takes a <git-sha>, refuses latest, backs up the DB before migrating, and waits for /readyz
knowledge/DEPLOYMENT.md names stokgudang_db and stokgudang_user@'172.%', reads SELECT VERSION() first, and creates the user WITH caching_sha2_password (never mysql_native_password for a new account)
knowledge/DEPLOYMENT.md names SSH host vps-acme and Server playbook none
infra/nginx/nginx.conf proxies server_name stokgudang.example.com to 127.0.0.1:8085 and does not use default_server
Dockerfile runs as non-root, uses ENTRYPOINT (not CMD), and has a HEALTHCHECK on /readyz

The only .env is the gitignored local one (env-local.mjs values, no placeholder, no server secret); infra/deploy/.env.production.example holds no value and never the local sign-in admin@example.com / admin123
Claude did not run any command that changes the server (no DB creation, nginx, certbot, docker login, or deploy)

evals.prompt: Saya sudah punya monorepo 'klinikgigi' hasil skill ini (NestJS + React). Sekarang buatkan tampilan frontend-nya: halaman publik untuk booking jadwal dokter gigi dan dashboard admin klinik untuk mengelola jadwal & pasien. Target pengguna di Indonesia.
evals.expected_output: Before writing any UI code, Claude researches current sources on the internet about how clinic/dental booking sites and clinic admin dashboards are ideally and commonly designed, writes the findings, design direction, anti-patterns, and dated sources into knowledge/DESIGN.md, then builds the screens through the frontend-design skill following that brief.
assertions: Claude performed web research (WebSearch/WebFetch or browser) BEFORE writing UI components
Research covers real products in the clinic/dental booking category, at least one design system or platform guideline, and at least one UX research source
knowledge/DESIGN.md is filled: status no longer 'NOT RESEARCHED YET', research date set, findings, design direction, anti-patterns, and a Sources list with URLs and access dates
The brief distinguishes the public booking flow (patients, mostly phone) from the admin dashboard (staff, desktop) in devices and layout
Locale is handled for Indonesia (id-ID dates, Indonesian copy)
No competitor branding, logos, or copy were copied into the project
UI implementation follows the brief and uses the frontend-design skill; theme values live in apps/web/src/theme/

evals.prompt: Buatkan project back-office gudang bernama "stok-gudang": backend Go, frontend React. Staff harus login dengan email dan password, admin bisa kelola akun staff, lalu ada modul produk dan stok. Pakai modul dari library yang sudah ada kalau cocok. Jangan deploy.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds a Go project, reads the module library catalog, presents one install/adapt/build table for confirmation (auth + users + app-shell + ui-core installed, products/stock built), installs with module.mjs in dependency order with UserStore wired to users, and builds products/stock as custom modules that import no other module.
assertions: Reads the library CATALOG.md (or module.mjs list) before writing feature code
Shows one capability table (install / install + adapt / build) and asks for confirmation once before installing
Installs with module.mjs add (not by copying files): ui-core and app-shell before users, users before auth
Wires auth with --port UserStore=users
modules.lock.json exists after installing
Products and stock are built as new modules following the standard (ports/ for what they need, registered in registry.go and app/modules.ts)
No module imports another module (only the composition root does, through adapters)
Protected routes in custom modules use d.Auth.Require rather than importing auth

evals.prompt: Buatkan monorepo baru 'kasirku' backend Go + React dan siapkan deploy-nya ke server.
evals.expected_output: Before writing deploy facts, Claude looks for knowledge/DEPLOYMENT.md and ~/.config/rudis-monorepo/targets.json; finding neither, it asks the user for the SSH host alias, whether the server keeps a playbook / app registry, the registry owner, and the domain, offers to save the answers to targets.json, and does not guess any of them.
assertions: Claude asks for the SSH host alias, playbook (or none), registry owner, and domain before scaffolding with deploy flags
Claude offers to save the answers to ~/.config/rudis-monorepo/targets.json and writes it only after a yes
No port, SSH host, owner, or domain is invented; an unknown value is left as a __PLACEHOLDER__ marker
No server name from outside the conversation (e.g. a previous project's host) appears in the generated files
Claude did not run any command that changes the server
